title: Senior Product Manager - Platform Integrations
description:
**About Payoneer**
 Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.
   

  

 By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi\-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.
   

  

**The Role**
 Make every Payoneer capability accessible programmatically — through self\-serve APIs and AI\-native MCP interfaces — so customers and their AI agents can work with Payoneer wherever they operate, without opening the app.
   

  

 This is a new, high\-ownership area with no prior product owner — strategy, vision, and roadmap are yours to define. Payoneer already exposes hundreds of APIs, but only a fraction of customers can reach them and onboarding still takes weeks, capping adoption and the retention upside of integrated customers. As Senior Product Manager, Platform Integrations, you’ll own the strategy to close that gap, turn API access into a growth and retention lever, and take our MCP / AI\-native layer from proof\-of\-concept to production. You’ll work across Product, R\&D, Risk, Security, Legal, and GTM, and report into the Platform Product leadership team.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Take the MCP to production. Take Payoneer’s MCP work from proof\-of\-concept to production – exposing capabilities such as balance, transactions, payouts, and FX as tools that AI agents (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude) can call. Partner with Account Security and Core Foundations on auth, governance, and a secure read\-first rollout.
* Turn API access into a growth lever. Payoneer exposes hundreds of APIs, but only a fraction of customers can reach them and onboarding still takes weeks — capping adoption and the retention upside of integrated customers. Own the strategy to close that gap end\-to\-end, with self\-serve onboarding, developer experience, and API governance as the execution threads.
* Turn demand into a roadmap. Synthesize signals from CSM, Sales, and regional GTM teams (EMEA, LATAM, APAC) into a prioritized, evidence\-backed roadmap, and prove the business case – including the retention impact of API\-integrated customers.
* Lead cross\-functionally. Coordinate Risk (eligibility), Security (MCP/API risk model), Legal (data sharing and LLM integrations), Pricing, and Engineering to unblock launches and land outcomes, not just features.


**Who You Are**
* 6\+ years in product management, including significant experience owning API, platform, developer\-facing, or integration products.
* Strong technical fluency: comfortable discussing REST APIs, webhooks/events, authentication (OAuth), SDKs, and integration architecture directly with engineers.
* Proven ability to take an ambiguous, unowned area and create clarity – strategy, roadmap, and shipped product – with a high degree of independence.
* Track record of building self\-serve or developer experiences, and of driving measurable adoption and time\-to\-value improvements.
* Excellent cross\-functional leadership: you align Risk, Security, Legal, GTM, and Engineering around shared outcomes and keep them moving.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills; you frame decisions with data and are comfortable defining metrics where none exist.
* Fluent English, written and verbal. Based in India with the ability to work in a hybrid model and collaborate across global time zones.


**What Could Set You Apart**
* Hands\-on exposure to AI\-native interfaces – Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent tooling, or LLM integrations – and a point of view on where agent\-driven finance is heading.
* Experience in fintech, payments, or another regulated environment, and fluency working within compliance, risk, and security constraints.
* Familiarity with API aggregators and ERP/accounting ecosystems (e.g. Codat, Rutter, Xero, QuickBooks, NetSuite).
* Experience productizing an existing internal API surface – governance, standardization, and developer adoption at scale.
* A builder’s bias: you’ve turned a first customer or first use case into a repeatable, scalable product.


**The Payoneer Ways of Working**
**Act as our customer’s partner on the inside**
*Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further.*
**Do it. Own it.**
*Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do.*
**Continuously improve**
*Always striving for a higher standard than our last.*
**Build Each Other Up**
*Helping each other grow, as professionals and people.*
 If this sounds like a business, a community, and a mission you want to be part of, apply today.
   

  

*We are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. COMPANY PROFILE Bain & Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world s most ambitious changemakers define the future. Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperforming the competition, and redefine industries. We complement our tailored, integrated expertise with a vibrant ecosystem of digital innovators to deliver better, faster, and more enduring outcomes. The firm established several functions in the Indian market early 2000s and its remit across functions has expanded over time. Since 2019, these functions have become part of Global Business Services (GBS). Global Business Services (GBS) is a network of five interconnected business functions hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals - serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics - who support our offices globally. Our mantra of shared innovation, seamless execution, underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally. WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world s best places to work. We are currently the top-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally. Position Summary Global Training at Bain builds capabilities through a range of learning options. This includes live virtual and in-person programs, apprenticeship, coaching, mentoring, social, and self-directed digital learning. We are expanding the range and reach of digital/online learning at Bain through next generation content and engaging learner experiences. The Manager, Digital Learning Systems will work within Bain s Global Training team to provide technical and functional support to the core learning platform (Springboard). This will include system updates, integrations, analysing new functionality and its impact, and configuration changes to enable new features. Other responsibilities of this role include measuring learning impact through reporting solutions, drawing insights to influence product decisions, and maintenance of technical standards (xAPI and SCORM) in integrations and platform standards audits. Essential Functions: Support, configure and administer learning systems, and system upgrades Build and maintain deep technical knowledge of all relevant learning platforms and content technology (i.e., LMS/LXP, eLearning software, video delivery system, content libraries) Troubleshoot customer requests raised through ServiceNow tickets and maintain the agreed SLAs Conduct regular quality checks to ensure learning technology is fully operational; react quickly and efficiently to customer feedback/requests including troubleshooting or escalation Develop test plans, monitor acceptance criteria, communicate new feature releases, and coordinate with vendor/Bains Technology Services Group (TSG) for resolution Test and maintain technical integration with other Bain HR and content systems Serve as advisor to Global Training team for process improvements to global/local system functionality Review upcoming product updates from the LXP supplier and identify potential backlog items that may be impacted 
 Use robust analytics to drive adoption and utilization of Springboard Audit and maintain all learning records and ensure consistency and quality of all data from learning systems (LXP, Google Analytics); improve analytics over time In coordination with Analytics team, develop a set of regular metrics to support analysis and measurement of self-directed content effectiveness Analyse learning data and learning dashboards to advise suitable adoption initiatives Actively promote the learning systems and functionality across general consulting and business function/expert/engine 2 employees globally Draw conclusions from data, identify key trends and making recommendations 
 Programs manage and coordinate technology initiatives within learning ecosystem Work in an agile environment to ensure product backlog items are tracked and updated in Trello boards Support the Product Manager with project management activities, providing timely and accurate information Maintain plans, records, spreadsheets, trackers and databases Create high-quality, accurate documentation, including meeting minutes Manage and drive data analysis within the coordination team and communicate to stakeholders Anticipate risks, resolve issues and initiate corrective action as appropriate 
 Communicate and present insights to diverse audience across the organisation Use Bain tools and presentation templates to ensure that insights drawn are communicated across the organisation Share frequent progress updates with our team, and stakeholders Education Required - BA/BS or equivalent, with strong academic credentials or equivalent experience Preferred - Any certification or diploma in learning technologies, system implementation, and learning data analysis Experience 2+ years of experience with learning or HR technology tools (learning management systems, learning experience platforms, eLearning authoring software, content management systems, etc.); experience with implementations a plus. Experience with learning standards including SCORM, AICC, and/or xAPI for learning data analysis Reporting tools and experience in analysing large data sets and using the information for continuous improvements Proficiency with Microsoft Excel (including dynamic formula construction, nested formulas and VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables) and other Office products (Teams, Word, PowerPoint) Preferred Experience with LRS databases to derive insights SQL or Relational Database Management Experience Experience working for a global company and coordinating complex schedules Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Required: Experience in computer systems validation, and learning management functional systems domain Data analysis in the context of tracking budget, penetration of trainings, talent High proficiency with Microsoft Office and demonstrated experience with reporting and presentation tools required Excellent written and verbal skills and the ability to communicate well with all levels of the organization Time management and the ability to prioritize set goals and finish deliverables on time Demonstrate entrepreneurship - takes initiative, focuses on customers and improves performance Knowledge of principles, training methods, and techniques for adult learners Excellent planning and organizational skills, with the proven ability to prioritize, handle multiple assignments and work accurately within tight timelines Ability to take the initiative and lead the execution of small projects Passion for business and learning, intellectual curiosity, and learning agility Excellent team player and aligned to Bain operating principles

title: Product Lead - Cloud Migration (Pega)
description:

The ideal candidate should possess a strong technical foundation along with a product-oriented mindset, enabling them to drive roadmap planning, stakeholder alignment, and cross-functional execution. This role requires close collaboration with technology, product, and business teams to ensure smooth migration, modernization, and delivery of scalable cloud solutions. Key Responsibilities Lead end-to-end Pega On-Prem to Cloud migration initiatives. Drive product strategy, roadmap planning, and execution for cloud modernization programs. Collaborate with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to align project goals and priorities. Facilitate decision-making across technical and functional teams. Communicate project progress, risks, and updates to senior leadership and stakeholders. Ensure seamless transition, scalability, and optimization of cloud-based solutions. Utilize data-driven insights and analytics to support strategic decisions (preferred). Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure timely delivery and successful implementation. Required Skills & Qualifications 10+ years of overall experience in Product Management / Technology Leadership roles. Strong experience working on enterprise cloud migration or modernization projects. Experience with Pega platforms and enterprise application environments. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Proven ability to drive product roadmaps and collaborate across technology and product teams. Strong technical understanding of cloud technologies and system architecture. Experience working with senior leadership and managing cross-functional communication. Preferred Skills Exposure to data analytics and reporting tools such as Power BI. Experience in cloud transformation programs within large enterprise environments. Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies.

title: Group Product Manager I
description:
JOB PURPOSE: The Product Manager 1 for PT Technology supports the delivery and management of specific product areas within the PT portfolio, contributing to the successful execution of product initiatives that drive customer and business value. This role focuses on translating product goals into clear requirements, supporting the development and maintenance of product roadmaps, and coordinating closely with cross-functional teams to ensure high-quality and timely delivery. Operating in a dynamic and evolving environment, the role requires analyzing customer and business needs, prioritizing features, and tracking progress against defined outcomes. The role requires partnership with engineering, design, and operations teams to support sprint planning, backlog management, and release readiness, ensuring product releases meet defined standards and expectations. The role requires strong attention to detail, curiosity, and a proactive mindset to learn from data, feedback, and outcomes - building the foundation for growth into broader product ownership and leadership responsibilities. 
 KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES: - Support the end-to-end delivery of assigned product features or modules. 
 - Contribute to defining product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria based on customer and business needs. 
 - Collaborate with engineering, design, and operations teams to ensure clear understanding of requirements and smooth delivery within sprints. 
 - Participate in backlog refinement, sprint planning, and release activities to support timely and quality product releases. - Track product performance metrics, customer feedback, and adoption data to identify improvement opportunities. 
 - Assist in maintaining up-to-date product documentation, roadmaps, and progress reports. 
 - Coordinate with cross-functional teams to manage dependencies, address issues, and ensure alignment on delivery milestones. 
 - Conduct basic market and user research to support prioritization and feature validation. 
 - Contribute to process improvements and operational efficiency within the product development cycle. 
 - Learn and apply best practices in product management, customer focus, and agile delivery. 
 - Demonstrate DP World s values and principles in day-to-day activities, maintaining high standards of safety, ethics, and professional conduct. 
 - Perform other related duties as assigned to support the success of the PT product portfolio. 

 QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS: - Bachelor s/master s degree in business, Technology, or related field (MBA preferred). 
 - 4+ years in product management or related fields. 
 - Strong track record in innovation, and product execution. 
 - Strategic thinking in high-ambiguity environments. 
 - Expertise in customer experience, business dynamics, and competitive landscapes. 
 - Good communication and storytelling skills. 
 - Proficiency in building and scaling systems and processes. 
 - Strong problem-solving capabilities. 
 - An entrepreneurial mindset, with the tenacity to develop ideas independently and thrive in fast-paced environment is crucial.
